item.title: Android Software Engineer - AI Finance Agent at Bjak
item.description: Android Software Engineer role focused on building the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Position is based in Japan with hybrid work arrangement (3 days/week in office).
item.content:encoded:
Android Software Engineer role focused on building the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Position is based in Japan with hybrid work arrangement (3 days/week in office).

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Create mobile flows for insurance, payments, and financial services
  • Work with Coroutines, Flow, and modern Android architecture
  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure stable, secure performance
  • Role is hybrid based in Japan, requiring office presence 3 days/week
  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support available for overseas applicants

item.title: Senior Software Engineer - Engage Studio at Treasure AI
item.description: Treasure AI is looking for a Senior Software Engineer for their Engage Studio in Tokyo. While primarily a full-stack role, mobile development experience is listed as a nice-to-have qualification.
item.content:encoded:
Treasure AI is looking for a Senior Software Engineer for their Engage Studio in Tokyo. While primarily a full-stack role, mobile development experience is listed as a nice-to-have qualification.

  • Full-stack role with Java, Go, Kotlin, Ruby, JavaScript stack
  • Mobile or SDK development experience is a plus
  • Partial remote work available
  • Japanese not required, business-level English needed
  • Residents of Japan only, no visa sponsorship
